description: Built a financial NLP system predicting next-day stock price direction from 1.4M headlines and 20.9M stock records.
highlights: Built an end-to-end pipeline covering data cleaning, temporal alignment, bigram/trigram NLP feature extraction, and FinBERT sentiment classification on 50K headlines using HuggingFace Transformers and Scikit-learn.
Trained a Random Forest classifier with 54.1% mean 5-fold cross-validation accuracy; evaluated Logistic Regression and FinBERT baselines to compare LLM-derived signals against traditional ML.
Presented findings and model trade-offs in weekly fellow cohort reviews, incorporating mentor feedback to refine feature engineering choices and strengthen the final report.

description: Built an LLM-powered monitoring pipeline using JFR telemetry to detect subtle regressions across critical Java services.
highlights: Reduced LLM context and inference cost by >95%, compressing ~43K JFR data tokens to ~2K through visualization.
Automated root-cause analysis by using internal MCP tools to correlate logs, reducing hours of manual investigation.
Integrated Slack alerts, delivering service reports with embedded Grafana links, helping on-calls triage issues faster.

description: Developed RAG pipelines integrating retrieval models with LLMs, achieving ~80% accuracy on complex search queries.
highlights: Co-developed a large-scale graph visualization tool enabling 10K+ node exploration for social-network analysis.
Reduced Docker image size by ~35% using multi-stage builds, improving deployment speed and lowering AWS costs.
Automated Docker container restarts using bash scripts triggered by cron, preventing hours of monthly downtime.

description: Built a backend service using Flask to significantly accelerate on-call engineers' response to deployment issues.
highlights: Implemented a singleton database class to manage SQL connections, significantly reducing connection overhead.
Achieved ~98% test coverage with Pytest unit and integration tests, ensuring API reliability and stability.
Delivered regular sprint updates, enabling faster iteration through rapid feedback loops and timely ticket resolution.
